findings.description: Privileged password stored in plaintext or reversible form, with no hashed secret
findings.remediation: Replace 'enable password' with 'enable secret <hash>' (IOS), use encrypted-password (JunOS) or ENC-hashed admin passwords (FortiOS). Hashed secrets cannot be read back from the configuration.

Enable centralised AAA: 'aaa new-model' with RADIUS/TACACS+ method lists (IOS), 'authentication-order' with radius/tacplus servers (JunOS), or remote-auth admins backed by 'config user radius' (FortiOS).

findings.description: Telnet permitted for device management (cleartext credentials)
findings.remediation: Allow SSH only: 'transport input ssh' on all VTY lines (IOS), remove 'system services telnet' (JunOS), remove 'telnet' from interface allowaccess (FortiOS).

findings.description: Passwords stored in plaintext: password encryption is not enabled
findings.remediation: Store credentials hashed: 'secret' instead of 'password' (type 8/9 where supported) and 'service password-encryption' as a minimum on IOS; encrypted-password on JunOS; ENC admin passwords on FortiOS. Remove default credentials.

findings.description: ACL contains unrestricted 'permit any any' (allows all traffic)
findings.remediation: Replace 'permit any any' entries (or all/all/ALL accept policies) with rules naming specific sources, destinations and services. End every ACL with an explicit deny and document each permit.

findings.description: Management interface has no inbound ACL applied
findings.remediation: Apply an inbound ACL/filter to every management interface that admits only known management hosts and the required protocols (SSH, SNMP, HTTPS).

findings.description: SNMPv1/v2c community string is a default or easily guessed value
findings.remediation: Replace default and short community strings with long random values (8+ characters, mixed classes). Migrate to SNMPv3 with SHA authentication and AES privacy, then remove v1/v2c communities.

findings.description: SNMP community is not restricted to known management hosts
findings.remediation: Bind every community to an ACL or client list of NMS addresses (IOS: 'snmp-server community <str> RO <acl>'; JunOS: 'clients'; FortiOS: community 'hosts').

findings.description: Plain-text HTTP management access is enabled
findings.remediation: Disable HTTP management ('no ip http server'; remove 'http' from web-management or allowaccess) and use HTTPS with TLS 1.2 or later and a valid certificate.
Send logs to at least one remote collector ('logging host <ip>'; JunOS 'syslog host'; FortiOS 'log syslogd setting'). Centralised logs are required for security monitoring and incident response.
Enable a local log buffer ('logging buffered 65536 informational'; JunOS 'syslog file'; FortiOS memory/disk logging) as a fallback when the collector is unreachable.

findings.description: NTP not configured; device clock may be unsynchronised
findings.remediation: Configure at least two trusted NTP servers. Accurate time is needed for log correlation, certificate validation and AAA event ordering.

findings.description: Interface is active but has no IP address or description assigned
findings.remediation: Shut down unused interfaces and describe every active one ('description <purpose>') so the inventory stays auditable.
